entry: PuzzleText.mount({ stage, paragraph, assembleOpts?, pinVH? }) | PuzzleText.buildAssembly(el, tl, position, opts)
rules: words NEVER go invisible — opacity stays 1; assembly is color-only gray→ink
scatter is wide diagonal on BOTH axes + slight rotate/skew
font is SANS grotesque, NOT serif
split is word-level only (letters banned, D12)
scatter <-> assemble ONLY — no card, no image, no finale, no next section

maxY.meaning: max vertical scatter (+/-); wide diagonal, both axes

rotate.meaning: max per-word rotation in scattered state

skew.meaning: max per-word skewX (italic-drift feel) in scattered state

scaleNear.meaning: scale of a word AT home (closest)

scaleFar.meaning: scale of the farthest word (farther = larger)

ghostNear.meaning: scattered tint of the nearest word (darker gray)

ghostFar.meaning: scattered tint of the farthest word (lighter gray)

stagger.meaning: timeline-position offset between words, reading order

ease.meaning: the one hard expo-out ease (CustomEase 0.16,1,0.3,1; fallback power4.out)

pinVH.meaning: pin length of the scrubbed scatter<->assemble move (mount only)
